correctness.rationale: The Fourier eigenvalues E_k=2J cos((2 pi k+phi)/N) are distinct except phi modulo 2pi equals 0 or pi; degeneracies pair k with -k (zero) or -1-k (pi). Each Fourier mode contributes seed spectral weight 1/N, so generic dephased cyclic density is the maximally mixed state and all N Krylov populations equal 1/N. Even N half-flux has all paired weights 2/N, giving m equal populations; at zero flux the reflection-shell Lanczos vectors and finite cosine-square sums give endpoint/interior populations, with the odd-N pi case gauge equivalent to minus the zero-flux Hamiltonian. Independent NumPy Hamiltonian/Lanczos/eigenprojection dephasing reproduced every branch for N=3..12, not relying on source claimed populations. Spectral theory and finite geometric-series identities prove all N; noncommuting infinite-time and phi limits arise from fixed-time continuity versus dephasing degeneracy.
